title: Your Voice Cloning System is Secretly a Voice Anonymizer
abstract: arXiv:2608.27360v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Speaker anonymization suppresses speaker-identifying attributes from speech while preserving linguistic content and quality. We propose repurposing XTTSv2, a multilingual voice cloning model trained on 27k hours of speech, for speaker anonymization without retraining. Our key insight is that XTTSv2's voice cloning capabilities preserve prosodic structure independently of speaker identity, enabling voice conversion by conditioning on a pseudo-speaker. We introduce an iterative refinement strategy that balances privacy and utility by maximizing a harmonic mean of speaker dissimilarity and intelligibility. Evaluated on seven European languages across CommonVoice and Multilingual LibriSpeech, our system achieves near-optimal privacy (EER $\approx$ 0.49), competitive intelligibility, and substantially better speech quality than dedicated anonymization baselines, while requiring no language-specific training. translated_title: 你的语音克隆系统其实是语音匿名化器
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.27360v1 公告类型：新 摘要：说话人匿名化旨在从语音中抑制说话人身份特征，同时保留语言内容和质量。我们提出将XTTSv2——一个在27,000小时语音上训练的多语言语音克隆模型——重新用于说话人匿名化，而无需重新训练。我们的关键见解是，XTTSv2的语音克隆能力能够独立于说话人身份保留韵律结构，从而通过基于伪说话人进行条件化实现语音转换。我们引入了一种迭代优化策略，通过最大化说话人差异度和可理解度的调和平均值来平衡隐私与实用性。在CommonVoice和多语言LibriSpeech上跨越七种欧洲语言的评估中，我们的系统实现了接近最优的隐私保护（等错误率≈0.49）、有竞争力的可理解度，并且语音质量显著优于专门的匿名化基线，同时无需特定语言的训练。我们在此发布代码：https://
tldr: 我们利用现成的语音克隆模型XTTSv2，无需重新训练即可实现高效的说话人匿名化，通过迭代策略平衡隐私与语音质量，在多语言测试中达到接近最优的隐私保护。
en_tdlr: We repurpose the off-the-shelf voice cloning model XTTSv2 for speaker anonymization without retraining, achieving near-optimal privacy with an iterative strategy that balances privacy and speech quality across multiple languages.
